text: SoL-dsh 是适用于 DSH 网页客户端的效率插件，通过 Host bundle 接入工具执行和上下文流程，并在 Client 增加会话状态显示。启用 ObservationPack 后，超过阈值的纯文本工具结果归档到本地，上下文仅保留句柄，需要时可按字节偏移分页读回。输入框下方的面板汇总会话节省情况，每轮尾部显示机制命中数。插件还提供动作融合、日志回执和在线上下文压缩开关，默认关闭。适合希望减少长工具输出占用并查看会话统计的 DSH 用户。日志归约会把符合条件的构建或测试输出发送至当前配置的 LLM 路由处理。

SoL-dsh archives large plain-text tool results locally for paged retrieval in DSH. Its UI summarizes session savings. Optional switches enable action fusion, log receipts, and context compaction; all start off. Log reduction sends eligible command output through DSH's configured LLM route.
工具返回的长文本老占上下文，能不能只放个引用，需要时再分段读？
想在 DSH 里看到这轮和整个会话大概省了多少 token。
Can I keep oversized tool output out of the prompt and retrieve the original in pages when needed?
SoL-dsh 的功能「长工具结果归档与分页召回」：启用 ObservationPack 后，超过阈值的纯文本工具结果会被存到本地，模型上下文收到带 ID 的摘要句柄；模型调用 obs_recall 并提供字节偏移即可分段取回原文。
SoL-dsh 使用前须知：启用日志归约时，符合条件的命令输出会作为用户消息发给 DSH 当前路由的 provider/model；provider 或 model 可留空以使用默认路由。

@jackiehank/sol-dsh README · SoL-dsh：中文 | [English](README.en.md)

[](https://www.dsh.so/artifact/sol-dsh/?ref=badge)

把 [NVlabs/SoL-Pi](https://github.com/NVlabs/SoL-Pi) 的四种效率机制适配为
**DeepSeek Harness（DSH）** 的 Cordis 插件包。四个机制**默认全关**，装好后在插件页逐个打开。

仓库 <https://github.com/jackiehank/SoL-dsh>（MIT），包名 `@jackiehank/sol-dsh`，
在 DSH **0.2.1-rc.3** 上实测。

@jackiehank/sol-dsh README · SoL-dsh：| 机制 | 英文全名 | 短名 | 一句话 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 动作融合 | Action Fusion | 融合 | `edit`/`write` 后在同一调用里跑校验/构建命令，省一次模型往返 |
| 长输出寄存 | ObservationPack | 寄存 | 超大工具结果存到本地，上下文只留句柄，需要时精确分页召回 |
| 诊断日志回执 | Evidence-Preserving Reducer | 回执 | 构建/测试日志压成逐字可核验的回执，对不上就退回原文 |
| 在线上下文压缩 | Online Context Compact | 压缩 | 计划步骤完成点触发原生 compaction，压缩后同一 turn 继续 |

@jackiehank/sol-dsh README · 界面：启用后有两处常驻显示，都是加法、不覆盖 DSH 原有 UI：

- **每轮尾行**：一轮结束时一行
  `本轮：融合 1 · 寄存 1 · 回执 0 · 压缩 0`（四项全零时不显示）；
- **输入框下方**：`已省 12.3k tok · 16.8%`，点击展开本会话的节省明细
  （寄存 / 回执 / 压缩 / 融合与百分比）。数字来自 Host 侧按整条会话日志折叠的投影，
  分页、重启、关掉机制都不会把历史清零。

设置入口：插件页里 **SoL-dsh 效率包** 的详情 → **机制开关**，四个开关即时生效并写回
profile 配置。

@jackiehank/sol-dsh README · 桌面端（DSH Desktop，0.2.1-rc.3 实测）：1. 侧栏打开 **插件**；
2. 点 **添加插件**（或旁边的箭头 → **安装第三方插件**）；
3. 填 Git 地址 `github:jackiehank/SoL-dsh`，安装；
4. 装完**刷新页面**——Client 半按包名进模块图，旧页面不会自己长出尾行、节省面板和开关。

装完四个机制都是关的，在插件页本包的 **机制开关** 里打开需要的机制。

桌面 profile 由 Electron 持有，CLI 会拒绝它的插件管理请求；桌面端就在应用内装，
不要手改 profile 目录。

@jackiehank/sol-dsh README · 本地开发：仓库根 `pnpm install`，再用 `plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle` 指向仓库根（link 模式，
不是拷贝）；Host 半改动重载插件，Client 半改动刷新页面。

@jackiehank/sol-dsh README · 升级与卸载：- 桌面端没有“更新”按钮：包已经在 profile 里声明时，重复安装会被 `already-installed`
  拒绝。**先移除，再用同一个入口装新版本**。
- 卸载也在插件页做，会删掉依赖和组合包行；重装后如果开关回到默认关闭，在插件页重新打开即可。
- 升级或改过 Client 半之后都要**刷新页面**；Host 半改动则重载插件或重启 DSH。

@jackiehank/sol-dsh README · 配置：推荐用图形化开关；它等价于直接改 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`。手动配置时：

```yaml
- id: sol-dsh
  name: '@jackiehank/sol-dsh'
  config:
    version: 1

@jackiehank/sol-dsh README · 配置：| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | `1` | 只支持 1 |
| `actionFusion` | `false` | 动作融合 |
| `observationPack` | `false` | 长输出寄存 |
| `evidencePreservingReducer` | `false` | 诊断日志回执 |
| `evidencePreservingReducerProvider` | 空 | 回执用的 provider；留空 = 默认路由 |
| `evidencePreservingReducerModel` | 空 | 回执用的模型；留空 = 默认路由 |
| `onlineContextCompact` | `false` | 在线上下文压缩 |
| `cacheWriteReadRatio` | `12.5` | 与上游同名；当前保留并校验，暂未参与决策 |

@jackiehank/sol-dsh README · 配置：阈值不开放（10 KiB 寄存阈值、16 KiB/400 行召回、4 KiB 归约下限、20k token 压缩留尾等）。
DSH 特有的两件事走环境变量：

- `DSH_SOL_DSH_HOME`：归档根目录（默认 `<DSH_HOME>/sol-pi`）；
- `DSH_SOL_DSH_DIAGNOSTICS=1`：注册 `sol_dsh_status` 排障工具。

@jackiehank/sol-dsh README · 工作方式：- **动作融合**：在每个 agent 的 scope 注册遮蔽版 `edit`/`write`，schema 继承内建定义再加可选
  `then_run`；命令走 `pwsh`/`bash` 的同一套审批、沙箱与输出截断。
- **长输出寄存**：`tools/post-execute` 在结果落日志前替换 `content`，`value` 不动；原文按内容寻址
  归档，`obs_recall {id, offset}` 按字节分页读回。
- **诊断日志回执**：只处理 `pwsh`/`bash` 的构建/测试类命令输出（≥ 4 KiB、无疑似密钥），
  先归档再用 `ctx.llm` 做一次受限调用；回执里的每条引文必须逐字出现在原文里，
  否则整体退回原文。
- **在线上下文压缩**：观察 `todo_write`，在“旧步骤变 completed”的边界用 `ctx.tokenMeter`
  选区间，经济性成立才调 `ctx.compaction.compactRegion`，不注入“继续工作”的消息。
@jackiehank/sol-dsh README · 工作方式：细节与取舍见 [`docs/plugin.md`](docs/plugin.md) 和 [`docs/issues/`](docs/issues/)。

@jackiehank/sol-dsh README · 兼容性与边界：- 只针对 DSH **0.2.1-rc.3** 验证；更老版本没有 `sessionProjections` 时，历史统计退回扫当前快照；
  `settings`/`configForms` 缺失时没有图形开关，机制仍可用 yml 配置；
- Host 半改动要重载插件；Client 半改动要**刷新页面**；
- 归档是本地明文，可能含日志里的敏感内容，`DSH_SOL_DSH_HOME` 不要指向共享目录；
- 回执有硬约束：逐字校验失败、疑似密钥、回执不比原文小都会回退，不硬压；
- `then_run` 的输出在 post-execute 之后追加，回执机制看不到它。

@jackiehank/sol-dsh README · 常见问题：- **插件页没有「机制开关」**：确认本包在插件列表里已启用；配置区只为声明了
  `plugins.bundle.config` 的包显示，Client 半没加载时刷新页面。
- **尾行不显示**：四项全零时不渲染；先打开机制，再跑一轮真的有命中的会话。
- **长输出寄存没触发**：只处理超过 10 KiB 的纯文本工具结果，`value` 和二进制结果不动。
- **回执没生成**：只对 `pwsh`/`bash` 的构建/测试类命令、输出 ≥ 4 KiB、且没有疑似密钥；
  逐字校验失败、回执不比原文小都会退回原文。
- **压缩没发生**：经济性不成立（省下的 token 抵不掉摘要成本或缓存失效）就不压。
- **升级后行为没变**：卸载再安装，然后刷新页面；桌面端没有原地更新。
- **排障**：`DSH_SOL_DSH_DIAGNOSTICS=1` 启动会注册 `sol_dsh_status` 工具，报告动作融合
  在各 agent 上的安装情况（`then_run` 是否可见、scoped 注册是否生效）。

@jackiehank/sol-dsh README · 开发：```powershell
pnpm install              # 在仓库根装依赖（schemastery/cosmokit）
node --test tests         # 纯函数 + 机制级测试
node --check client.js
```

目录：

```text
package.json             DSH bundle 清单（exports / dsh.bundle.patch / dsh.client）
lib/                     Host 半：四个机制、配置、会话节省投影
client.js                Client 半：插件页开关、每轮尾行、节省面板
cordis.patch.yml         插入插件行 + 默认配置（四个机制全关）

@jackiehank/sol-dsh README · SoL-dsh：[中文](README.md) | English

[](https://www.dsh.so/artifact/sol-dsh/?ref=badge)

Ports the four efficiency mechanisms of [NVlabs/SoL-Pi](https://github.com/NVlabs/SoL-Pi) to
**DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** as a Cordis plugin bundle. All four mechanisms are **off by default**;
turn them on one by one on the Plugins page after installing.

Repository <https://github.com/jackiehank/SoL-dsh> (MIT), package `@jackiehank/sol-dsh`,
verified on DSH **0.2.1-rc.3**.

@jackiehank/sol-dsh README · SoL-dsh：| Mechanism | Short name | In one line |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Action Fusion | Fusion | runs a validation/build command in the same call after `edit`/`write`, saving one model round-trip |
| ObservationPack | Pack | oversized tool results go to local storage, the context keeps only a handle and recalls exact pages on demand |
| Evidence-Preserving Reducer | Reducer | condenses build/test logs into verbatim-checkable receipts, falling back to the raw text when a quote does not match |
| Online Context Compact | Compact | triggers native compaction at a completed plan step and continues in the same turn |
@jackiehank/sol-dsh README · Surfaces：Once enabled there are two persistent surfaces. Both are additive and never cover DSH's own UI:

@jackiehank/sol-dsh README · Surfaces：Settings entry: the **SoL-dsh Efficiency Pack** card on the Plugins page → **Mechanism switches**.
The four switches apply immediately and write back to the profile config.

@jackiehank/sol-dsh README · DSH Desktop (verified on 0.2.1-rc.3)：The desktop profile is owned by Electron and the CLI refuses plugin-management requests for it;
install from inside the app, and don't edit the profile directory by hand.

@jackiehank/sol-dsh README · Upgrade and uninstall：- DSH Desktop has no "update" button: when the package is already declared in the profile, a
  second install is refused with `already-installed`. **Remove it first, then install the new
  version through the same entry point.**
- Uninstall also happens on the Plugins page; it removes the dependency and the bundle row. If the
  switches come back off after reinstalling, turn them on again on the Plugins page.
- **Refresh the page** after an upgrade or any Client-half change; reload the plugin (or restart
  DSH) after Host-half changes.

@jackiehank/sol-dsh README · Configuration：Prefer the graphical switches; they are equivalent to editing the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`.
For manual configuration:

```yaml
- id: sol-dsh
  name: '@jackiehank/sol-dsh'
  config:
    version: 1

@jackiehank/sol-dsh README · Configuration：| Key | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | `1` | only 1 is supported |
| `actionFusion` | `false` | Action Fusion |
| `observationPack` | `false` | ObservationPack |
| `evidencePreservingReducer` | `false` | Evidence-Preserving Reducer |
| `evidencePreservingReducerProvider` | empty | provider used by the reducer; empty = default routing |
| `evidencePreservingReducerModel` | empty | model used by the reducer; empty = default routing |
| `onlineContextCompact` | `false` | Online Context Compact |
| `cacheWriteReadRatio` | `12.5` | same name as upstream; validated and kept, not used in decisions yet |

@jackiehank/sol-dsh README · How it works：- **Action Fusion**: registers shadowed `edit`/`write` in each agent's scope; the schema extends
  the built-in definition with an optional `then_run`. Commands go through the same approvals,
  sandbox, and output truncation as `pwsh`/`bash`.
- **ObservationPack**: `tools/post-execute` replaces `content` before the result reaches the log;
  `value` is untouched. The original is archived by content address, and `obs_recall {id, offset}`
  reads it back page by page by byte offset.
- **Evidence-Preserving Reducer**: only handles the output of `pwsh`/`bash` build/test commands
  (≥ 4 KiB, no likely secrets). It archives first, then makes one constrained `ctx.llm` call.
  Every quote in the receipt must appear verbatim in the original; otherwise the whole receipt
  falls back to the raw text.
- **Online Context Compact**: watches `todo_write`; at the boundary where an old step becomes
  `completed` it picks a region with `ctx.tokenMeter` and calls `ctx.compaction.compactRegion`
  only when the economics work. It never injects a "keep working" message.
@jackiehank/sol-dsh README · How it works：Details and trade-offs: [`docs/plugin.md`](docs/plugin.md) and [`docs/issues/`](docs/issues/).

@jackiehank/sol-dsh README · FAQ：- **No "Mechanism switches" on the Plugins page**: make sure this bundle is enabled in the plugin
  list. The config section is only rendered for packages that declare `plugins.bundle.config`;
  refresh the page if the Client half hasn't loaded.
- **No per-turn tail**: it is not rendered when all four are zero; enable a mechanism and run a
  turn that actually hits it.
- **ObservationPack never triggers**: it only handles plain-text tool results over 10 KiB; `value`
  and binary results are untouched.
- **No reducer receipt**: only `pwsh`/`bash` build/test-like commands with ≥ 4 KiB of output and
  no likely secrets qualify; a failed verbatim check or a receipt no smaller than the original
  falls back to the raw text.
- **No compaction**: when the economics don't work (the saved tokens can't offset the summary cost
  or cache invalidation), nothing is compacted.
- **Behavior unchanged after an upgrade**: uninstall and reinstall, then refresh the page; DSH
  Desktop has no in-place update.
